content:
Deletes the specified profile. The type of profile to delete depends on the sensor_type  path
parameter, which can be set to either agent  or scanners .
You can monitor the status of deletion request via the Get agent task status or Get scanner task
status endpoint.
Note: If the agent or scanner profile has any assigned agents or scanners, they will be reassigned to
the default agent or scanner profile.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "agent"
"scanners"
The type of sensor. Use agent  for agent profiles or scanners  for
scanner profiles.
string <uuid>
The unique identifier (UUID) of the profile.
